Requirement / Control: Send an xAPI 1.0.3 statement to NELC's LRS for every learner action (login, enrol, watch, attempt, complete, earn).
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Every learner event dispatches through XapiService.emit(), which builds an xAPI 1.0.3 statement, persists it to xapi_statements, then queues it for POST to the NELC LRS.
Evidence Location: Admin > Integrations > NELC > Statement Log; GET /admin/integrations/nelc/xapi/log

Requirement / Control: xAPI queue must be resilient — no learner-facing request blocked by an LRS timeout and no event lost on transient failure.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Statements are persisted first with status='pending', then a BullMQ job (XapiProcessor, concurrency 4) dispatches to the LRS; retries are handled inside LrsClient and an hourly cron re-sweeps any pending/failed rows.
Evidence Location: xapi_transmissions table shows every attempt with http_status; Admin > NELC > Retry Failed
API / DB / Audit Trail: xapi-statements BullMQ queue; xapi_transmissions.http_status, error_text; POST /admin/integrations/nelc/xapi/retry/:id

Requirement / Control: xAPI statement retries must be idempotent — the same event must not create duplicates on the LRS.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: xapi_statements.id (UUID) is patched into the payload as the xAPI statement id after insert, so replaying the same row is a no-op on the LRS per xAPI spec.
Evidence Location: xapi_statements.id column matches payload.id JSON key; check via SQL: SELECT id, payload->>'id' FROM xapi_statements

Requirement / Control: Register enrolment events with verb IRI http://adlnet.gov/expapi/verbs/registered.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: emitCourseEnrollment() builds a Registered statement via buildRegisteredStatement() using NELC_VERB.REGISTERED and includes course description on this verb only.

Requirement / Control: Emit an Initialized statement (http://adlnet.gov/expapi/verbs/initialized) the first time a learner opens course content after enrolling.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: emitCourseInitialized() fires on first content open using buildInitializedStatement().

Requirement / Control: Video watched events must use the acrossx watched verb (https://w3id.org/xapi/acrossx/verbs/watched) — NOT the ADL 'experienced' verb.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: emitVideoWatched() uses NELC_VERB.WATCHED (acrossx namespace) paired with VIDEO activity type; ADL 'experienced' would be invisible to NELC's "watched content" check.

Requirement / Control: Emit Completed statements (http://adlnet.gov/expapi/verbs/completed) for lesson / module / course completion; activity type distinguishes level.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: emitLessonCompleted() and emitCourseCompleted() both use NELC_VERB.COMPLETED with the appropriate object.definition.type (LESSON, MODULE, or COURSE).

Requirement / Control: Emit Progressed statements for partial lesson / module progress with monotonically increasing values.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: emitCourseProgressed() emits progressed with score.raw 0-100; caller is responsible for only calling on strictly increasing values (NELC checklist 1.4).

Requirement / Control: Emit Attempted statements for every assessment attempt with sequential attempt IDs (NELC checklist 1.6) and result.success set from raw >= min (checklist 5.2).
PhysioGuidance Implementation: emitAssessmentSubmitted() counts prior submissions to compute attemptNo, sets min=passingMarks so validator's rule matches, and stamps result.success from the passed flag.

Requirement / Control: Emit Rated statements for course feedback with raw/min/max on a 0-5 scale plus a non-empty textual review (checklist 5.4).
PhysioGuidance Implementation: emitCourseRated() clamps rating 0-5, synthesises a default response string when reviewText is empty so the field is never blank.

Requirement / Control: Emit Earned statements for certificates / badges with the certificate URL in the jws-certificate-location extension.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: emitCertificateIssued() builds an EarnedStatement whose activity type = CERTIFICATE (Opigno namespace) and includes the download URL as context.extensions[jws-certificate-location].

Requirement / Control: Emit LoggedIn statement (http://adlnet.gov/expapi/verbs/logged-in) on user login — step 1 of Amna's compliance journey (National ID).
PhysioGuidance Implementation: emitLogin() fires from auth flow with the platform-level activity; browser info attached when available.

Requirement / Control: Emit Attended statement (http://adlnet.gov/expapi/verbs/attended) paired with VIRTUAL_CLASSROOM activity type for live webinar / Zoom attendance.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: emitWebinarAttended() dedupes across Zoom-webhook, Zoom-sync-cron, and manual-marking paths (checklist SEQ003) then emits attended with session duration as result.duration.

Requirement / Control: Every statement object.definition.type must be one of the seven NELC-accepted activity type IRIs (COURSE, MODULE, LESSON, VIDEO, UNIT_TEST, CERTIFICATE, VIRTUAL_CLASSROOM).
PhysioGuidance Implementation: NELC_ACTIVITY_TYPE constant enumerates all seven IRIs verbatim from the Msaaq reference SDK; builders select the correct one per statement type.

Requirement / Control: Every statement must carry the NELC platform extension (https://nelc.gov.sa/extensions/platform) with bilingual ar-SA + en-US name on context.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: getPlatformBlock() reads NELC_PLATFORM_NAME_EN + _AR from config and every statement builder attaches the extension via context.extensions.

Requirement / Control: NELC learner PII extensions (learner_mobile_no, learner_full_name, learner_nationality, date_of_birth) must be attached to statements when known.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: XapiContextHelper.getLearner() populates the profile block used by builders; nulls are omitted from the payload.
Evidence Location: Inspect xapi_statements.payload->'context'->'extensions' for the four learner keys

Requirement / Control: LMS URL and per-course program URL extensions must be present on every statement.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: helpers attach lms_url from nelc.config.ts and program_url from the course activity URL on every statement.

Requirement / Control: Assessment attempts must carry the tincanapi attempt-id extension so multiple statements from the same attempt are linkable.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: attempted.ts builder attaches http://id.tincanapi.com/extension/attempt-id using the sequential attempt number computed in xapi.service.ts.

Requirement / Control: Statement duration extensions must use ISO 8601 duration strings (https://nelc.gov.sa/extensions/duration).
PhysioGuidance Implementation: helpers.ts converts numeric seconds to ISO 8601 (e.g. PT30S) before attaching the duration extension.

Requirement / Control: Language codes on every statement must be BCP-47 (en-US or ar-SA) — internal user.language 'en' / 'ar' must be translated at emission time.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: toBcp47() maps internal 'en' -> 'en-US', 'ar' -> 'ar-SA' and is applied to every verb display map + context.language.

Requirement / Control: CRS001 — every non-course statement MUST carry contextActivities.parent[0] with the course activity type; context.platform and context.language must be present; verb display strings must match the canonical NELC map.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: backends/scripts/verify-nelc-journey.cjs walks the whole xapi_statements table and validates every statement against the CRS001 rule set (parent linkage, context.platform, context.language, verb display map) before staging->production cutover.
Evidence Location: Run the pre-flight script: DATABASE_URL=... node backends/scripts/verify-nelc-journey.cjs — prints PASS/FAIL per statement with the failing rule
API / DB / Audit Trail: Standalone validation script over xapi_statements table

Requirement / Control: xAPI 1.0.3 protocol version must be sent as X-Experience-API-Version header on every LRS request.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: XAPI_VERSION = '1.0.3' constant used by LrsClient when POSTing to the LRS.
Evidence Location: Request headers on POST to NELC_LRS_ENDPOINT — see xapi_transmissions.http_status

Requirement / Control: xapi_statements table is the canonical persistence — every attempted transmission is stored regardless of send outcome.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: xapi_statements schema (id, verb, actor_user_id, object_activity_id, object_type, course_id, enrollment_id, payload jsonb, status, created_at, sent_at) with CHECK constraint on status and indices for cron + admin filters.
Evidence Location: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM xapi_statements GROUP BY status; Admin > NELC > Stats page

Requirement / Control: nelc_audit_logs table records every administrative + teaching operation; INSERT-only for immutability (NELC requirement).
PhysioGuidance Implementation: NelcAuditService.log() only performs INSERT; there is no update or delete method. Table has indices on event_type, entity, user_id, created_at for query performance.
Evidence Location: Admin > Audit Logs page; GET /nelc-audit (paginated); GET /nelc-audit/export (CSV)

Requirement / Control: Session lifecycle events (started / ended / cancelled / finalized) must be audit-logged.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Sessions service emits SESSION_STARTED, SESSION_ENDED, SESSION_CANCELLED, SESSION_FINALIZED via NelcAuditService.log().
Evidence Location: SELECT * FROM nelc_audit_logs WHERE event_type IN ('session_started','session_ended','session_cancelled','session_finalized')

Requirement / Control: Attendance changes (manual mark, auto-sync from Zoom, Zoom join/leave, unverified confirmed) must be audit-logged.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Attendance service and Zoom webhook path both call NelcAuditService.log() with the ATTENDANCE_* event types plus metadata capturing old vs new value and Zoom join/leave timestamps.
Evidence Location: SELECT * FROM nelc_audit_logs WHERE event_type LIKE 'attendance_%'
API / DB / Audit Trail: nelc_audit_logs event types: attendance_marked_manual, attendance_auto_synced, attendance_zoom_join, attendance_zoom_leave, attendance_unverified_confirmed

Requirement / Control: Enrolment lifecycle (created, dropped, limit enforced) must be audit-logged.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Enrollments controller/service emits ENROLLMENT_CREATED / _DROPPED / _LIMIT_ENFORCED audit events.
Evidence Location: SELECT * FROM nelc_audit_logs WHERE event_type LIKE 'enrollment_%'
API / DB / Audit Trail: nelc_audit_logs event types: enrollment_created, enrollment_dropped, enrollment_limit_enforced

Requirement / Control: Assistant (TA) allocation / deallocation must be audit-logged.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: session-assistants module writes ASSISTANT_ALLOCATED / _DEALLOCATED rows on every add/remove.
Evidence Location: SELECT * FROM nelc_audit_logs WHERE event_type IN ('assistant_allocated','assistant_deallocated')

Requirement / Control: Zoom operations (meeting created, nightly sync completed, join link generated) must be audit-logged.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Zoom service and Zoom sync cron write ZOOM_MEETING_CREATED / ZOOM_SYNC_COMPLETED / ZOOM_JOIN_LINK_GENERATED events.
Evidence Location: SELECT * FROM nelc_audit_logs WHERE event_type LIKE 'zoom_%'
API / DB / Audit Trail: nelc_audit_logs event types: zoom_meeting_created, zoom_sync_completed, zoom_join_link_generated

Requirement / Control: Certificate revocation must be audit-logged.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Certificates service emits CERTIFICATE_REVOKED on admin revocation with metadata (reason + revoker id).

Requirement / Control: Course lifecycle events (submitted for review, changes requested, activated, deactivated, cancelled, rescheduled, ended auto/manual, completed manual, deleted) must be audit-logged.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Courses service writes COURSE_* events on every state transition; deletions from ended/archive also logged.
Evidence Location: SELECT * FROM nelc_audit_logs WHERE event_type LIKE 'course_%'
API / DB / Audit Trail: nelc_audit_logs event types: course_submitted_for_review, course_changes_requested, course_activated, course_deactivated, course_cancelled, course_rescheduled, course_ended_auto, course_ended_manual, course_completed_manual, course_deleted_from_ended, course_deleted_from_archive

Requirement / Control: Every automated compliance check outcome must be audit-logged so auditors can reconstruct the compliance state at any time.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Each compliance check emits either COMPLIANCE_CHECK_PASSED or COMPLIANCE_CHECK_FAILED into nelc_audit_logs with rule + detail metadata.
Evidence Location: SELECT * FROM nelc_audit_logs WHERE event_type IN ('compliance_check_passed','compliance_check_failed')

Requirement / Control: Automated Compliance Check #1 — Enrolment limit: session must not exceed course.max_enrollment; block over-registration.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: checkEnrollmentLimit() classifies the course (short vs long) via classifyCourse() and enforces the NELC max via getNelcMaxEnrollment(); enforcement blocks new enrolments and emits ENROLLMENT_LIMIT_ENFORCED.
Evidence Location: GET /nelc-compliance/session/:id — check with rule = 'enrollment_limit'; NELC clause NELC-VC-001

Requirement / Control: Automated Compliance Check #2 — Assistant allocation: >25 enrolled requires 1 TA; >35 requires 2 TAs.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: checkAssistantAllocation() applies ASSISTANT_THRESHOLD_LOW=25 / _MID=35 and returns failed when assigned < required; also surfaces on scorecard as ta_allocation.

Requirement / Control: Automated Compliance Check #3 — Zoom configuration: zoom / hybrid sessions must have a meeting id or join link.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: checkZoomConfiguration() marks failed when both session.meetingId and session.zoomLink are missing on a zoom/hybrid session.

Requirement / Control: Automated Compliance Check #4 — Scheduling: session must have scheduledAt and durationMinutes >= 15.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: checkScheduling() flags failed on missing scheduledAt and review when duration is under 15 minutes.

Requirement / Control: Automated Compliance Check #5 — Attendance tracking: every completed session must have attendance rows.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: checkAttendanceTracking() returns failed when a session is status='completed' and no attendance records exist for it; scorecard aggregates same rule across all completed sessions.

Requirement / Control: Course scorecard — bilingual title + description (Arabic + English) required.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Scorecard structure category checks courses.title/titleAr and courses.description/descriptionAr; missing Arabic marks the course failed.
Evidence Location: GET /nelc-compliance/course/:id/scorecard — checks 'bilingual_content' and 'bilingual_descriptions'; NELC clauses NELC-CS-004 / NELC-PL-003

Requirement / Control: Course scorecard — CME hours must be configured on CME-accredited courses.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: scorecard 'cme_hours_configured' check reads courses.cmeHours; review status when zero/null.

Requirement / Control: Course scorecard — self-paced / blended courses must have at least 3 modules AND every module must have materials.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Scorecard modules_count and modules_with_materials rules enforce minimum 3 modules with materials; NELC clauses NELC-CS-001 / NELC-CS-003.

Requirement / Control: WCAG accessibility — every course material must be scanned and pass the WCAG check.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: scorecard 'wcag_status' rule requires 100% of materials to be wcag_status='pass' or 'compliant'; physio-job-wcag-check batch scans materials.

Requirement / Control: Accessibility — every video must have captions AND a transcript.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Scorecard 'video_captions' (failed if any video missing captionsUrl) and 'video_transcripts' (review if any missing transcriptUrl); NELC clauses NELC-AC-002 / NELC-AC-003.

Requirement / Control: Assessment quality — >=80% of modules must have at least one assessment (blueprint coverage) and every published assessment must have submissions.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Scorecard blueprint_coverage rule grades >=80% pass / >=50% review / else failed; graded_submissions checks published-assessment submission counts.
Evidence Location: GET /nelc-compliance/course/:id/scorecard — rules 'blueprint_coverage' + 'graded_submissions'; NELC clauses NELC-AQ-001 / NELC-AQ-002

Requirement / Control: Instructor qualifications — course instructor must have the INSTRUCTOR role assigned AND credentials (resume) uploaded via role request.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Scorecard instructor_role check joins user_roles + roles for INSTRUCTOR; credentials_uploaded reads role_requests.resumeFiles array.
Evidence Location: GET /nelc-compliance/course/:id/scorecard — rules 'instructor_role' + 'credentials_uploaded'; NELC clauses NELC-IQ-001 / NELC-IQ-002

Requirement / Control: SCFHS / CME certificates — student attendance percentage must be visible to the reviewer for CME credit decisions.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Attendance percent is computed as (present + late) / completed_sessions * 100 in computeEligibility() and surfaced to the reviewer on the certificate approval page. Reviewer discretion is intentional (per client): no hard 75% system block — the human approver decides based on the displayed percentage.
Evidence Location: Certificate request review page — attendance_percent column on certificate_requests; SELECT attendance_percent FROM certificate_requests

Requirement / Control: Course rescheduling / cancellation must notify enrolled learners.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: COURSE_RESCHEDULED and COURSE_CANCELLED audit events are emitted; notifications service handles learner emails on the corresponding hooks.
Evidence Location: Admin > Audit Trail (course.update / course_duplicated events visible); nelc_audit_logs table

Requirement / Control: Certificate PDFs must include the accreditation number and be verifiable via a public verify URL.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Cert PDF template renders courses.accreditationNumber; /en/verify/:id resolves the request and returns approved/revoked status with SCFHS accreditation (e.g. ACA-409998457).

Requirement / Control: Every admin-facing NELC operation must be exposed via authenticated endpoints (JwtAuthGuard + RolesGuard, MANAGER / ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN only).
PhysioGuidance Implementation: xapi.admin.controller.ts, nelc-compliance.controller.ts, and nelc-audit.controller.ts all mount JwtAuthGuard + RolesGuard; xAPI admin endpoints are pinned to MANAGER/ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN.
Evidence Location: Admin UI: Settings > NELC Integration + Admin > Compliance dashboards

Requirement / Control: Admin must be able to inspect xAPI stream health (stats, log, retry).
PhysioGuidance Implementation: GET /xapi/stats returns total sent/pending/failed; GET /xapi/log lists statements with filters; POST /xapi/retry/:id re-queues a failed statement.

Requirement / Control: Admin must be able to test LRS connectivity + trigger Provider Joined / Left onboarding statements.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: POST /xapi/test-connection pings NELC (HTTP 200 verified live); POST /xapi/trigger/joined and /left emit the one-time onboarding statements. Admin UI exposes Test Connection button + Send joined/left triggers.
Evidence Location: Admin > NELC Integration page (live PROD env)

Requirement / Control: Audit log must be exportable to CSV for regulator review.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: GET /nelc-audit/export streams up to 10 000 rows as CSV; GET /nelc-compliance/export.csv exports the all-courses scorecard as CSV (UTF-8 BOM for Excel/Arabic).
Evidence Location: Admin UI > Audit Logs > Export button; Admin UI > NELC > Export report button

Requirement / Control: Per-course evidence bundle must be exportable as ZIP containing compliance checks + attendance + materials + assessments + instructor credentials + WCAG + ratings + policies.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: generateEvidenceBundle() zips cover-summary.txt + compliance-checks.json (with NELC clause mapping) + sessions.csv + attendance.csv + materials-audit.csv + assessment-results.csv + instructor-credentials.json + student-feedback.csv + accessibility-report.json + policies.json.
API / DB / Audit Trail: ZIP contents + NELC_CLAUSE_MAP static in service

Requirement / Control: LRS mode (staging vs production) must be admin-toggleable at runtime without a redeploy; env override must be manual (defence in depth).
PhysioGuidance Implementation: NelcModeService resolves mode from system_settings.nelc.mode > env NELC_LRS_MODE > 'staging' fail-safe; setMode() persists into system_settings, refuses if the target password isn't loaded, and invalidates caches.

Requirement / Control: All environment variables driving NELC integration must be documented (NELC_LRS_ENABLED, _MODE, _ENDPOINT_STAGING/_PROD, _USERNAME, _PASSWORD, _PASSWORD_PROD, PLATFORM_IDENTIFIER, PLATFORM_NAME_EN/_AR, LMS_URL, TIMEOUT_MS, MAX_ATTEMPTS).
PhysioGuidance Implementation: nelc.config.ts registers a nelc namespace with defaults + explanatory comments for every var; secrets live in GCP Secret Manager and are read by Cloud Run.

Requirement / Control: SDAIA — all learner data, backups, and infrastructure must reside inside Saudi Arabia (me-central2 / Dammam) with no cross-region replication.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Cloud SQL (physioguidance-db-me), Cloud Run services, Cloud Run Jobs, Memorystore Redis, Artifact Registry, GCS buckets (6, uniform bucket-level access), Load Balancer, and Cloud SQL backups all pinned to me-central2; no read replicas, no cross-region bucket replication.
Evidence Location: gcloud sql instances describe physioguidance-db-me --format='value(region)'; gcloud run services list --region=me-central2

Requirement / Control: Pre-flight verification script must catch xAPI spec violations before staging -> production cutover.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: backends/scripts/verify-nelc-journey.cjs walks xapi_statements and prints PASS/FAIL per statement against CRS001 rules (parent linkage / platform / language / verb display).
Evidence Location: Run: DATABASE_URL=$(gcloud secrets versions access latest --secret=DATABASE_URL) node backends/scripts/verify-nelc-journey.cjs

Requirement / Control: NELC-issued LRS credentials must be stored in GCP Secret Manager (never in git); staging + production must have separate secrets.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: NELC_LRS_PASSWORD (staging) and NELC_LRS_PASSWORD_PROD live in Secret Manager and are surfaced to Cloud Run env; NelcModeService refuses to switch mode when the target password is not loaded.
Evidence Location: Amna as GCP Project Owner can self-verify: Console > Secret Manager > filter 'NELC' (screenshot not required — owner has direct access)
API / DB / Audit Trail: GCP Secret Manager (physioguidance project); verify: gcloud secrets list --filter='name~NELC' --project=nelc-elearning-platform-479319

Requirement / Control: NELC platform info page must be publicly accessible on the LMS.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: strapi/src/api/nelc-page/ manages the /en/nelc content in Strapi CMS; page served at physioguidance.org/en/nelc with license number, license type, active status.

Requirement / Control: Signed NELC platform agreement retention (informational only — not a platform requirement).
PhysioGuidance Implementation: Signed NELC agreement is not tracked or referenced by the platform. Four SVG snapshots exist in frontend/public/NELC_agreement/ as visual assets only. Per client (Amna): no evidence of the signed PDF is required for handover.

Requirement / Control: Instructor policy preferences (enrolment limit, content review, NELC compliance enforcement, cancellation notice, weekly hours cap, auto-approve certificates) must be captured per instructor and included in evidence bundles.
PhysioGuidance Implementation: user_preferences.policy* columns store per-instructor policies; generateEvidenceBundle() writes them to policies.json in the ZIP.
Evidence Location: Evidence ZIP > policies.json; NELC clauses NELC-PL-001 / NELC-PL-002
